tools.name: site_info
tools.description: What Black Label Real Estate (blbestate.com) is, with links to its sitemap, docs, contact and every discovery document.

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Find pages on blbestate.com by words in their URL path (sitemap search). Returns URLs with a match score.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read one https://blbestate.com page as Markdown (Cloudflare Markdown for Agents) or stripped text, up to 40,000 characters.

tools.name: estate_stats
tools.description: Corpus totals for the public-records API (total_records, live_properties, archived_properties, states, counties, freshness).

tools.name: estate_coverage
tools.description: Per-state county and property counts for the live tier, plus the archived tier.

tools.name: estate_search
tools.description: Search public property records (preview tier: 25 rows per page). Category, value, date and toggle filters need a location (state, county, city, zip or map bounds).

tools.name: estate_parcel
tools.description: Exact parcel lookup by state and parcel_id.

tools.name: estate_owner
tools.description: An owner's parcel portfolio by state and owner name.

tools.name: estate_property_audit
tools.description: Latest dated public-record property audit for a parcel (3-mile context; no appraisal, ARV or profit claim).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Everything an agent can buy from Black Label Real Estate, with Stripe-verified prices, billing terms, delivery and live availability.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Start a purchase of one offer. Returns a continue_url: send the buyer there to pay on the Stripe-hosted checkout page. This tool does not charge anything.

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Read a checkout started with create_checkout.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_pages · Private data: site_info, estate_stats, estate_search, estate_property_audit · Public sink: create_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_pages · Private data: site_info, estate_stats, estate_search, estate_property_audit · Public sink: create_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
